faq.q: How much does Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth charge?
faq.a: Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth have offices?
faq.a: Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Law Office of Hollingsworth & Hollingsworth?
